comment: First match wins, tested against the minimal reproducer (min.jsonl / min-reject.jsonl). `tree_change`: would a fix change the trees of valid input that parses clean today (major) or only turn errors into trees (minor). Judgements are the author's, from probing (see the report), not measured.

accept.construct: U+0000 inside a string, template or comment
hashbang comment does not end at U+2028/U+2029 (ends only at LF)
accept.tree_change: major (edge: `#!<LS> x` is clean today with x inside the comment)

accept.construct: lone CR is not a line terminator for ASI
accept.tree_change: minor (probed: `a\r++b` is an ERROR today, no clean wrong tree seen)

accept.construct: no ASI after a multi-line comment that contains a line terminator
accept.tree_change:
minor (probed: `return /*
*/ 1` and `var a
/*
*/ ++b` are already right; `a /*
*/ ++b` is an ERROR today)

accept.construct: line break before `with` in import attributes

accept.re: export\{a as if\}|export\*as class|_import as import
accept.construct: reserved word as module export name (`export {a as if}`, `export * as class`, `export {x as import}`)
`export default function(){}` / `class{}` followed by a token on the same line (the declaration is parsed as an expression that wants `;`)
accept.tree_change: major (the value node kind changes for every `export default function(){}`)

accept.construct: class field without `;` followed on the next line by a `*` generator method
class field without `;` followed on the next line by a `[computed]` member
`yield` as an identifier in sloppy non-generator code (`yield=0`, `function f(yield){}`, `yield:;`, `yield()`)
invalid escape sequence in a tagged template (cooked value undefined)
no ASI before a JSX element after `let a` (`let a\n<a/>`)

reject.construct: bare `await` (identifier, label or no operand) accepted where `await` is a keyword: async function/arrow/method bodies, async parameters, module top level
reject.tree_change: n/a (invalid input); fix must keep `await` an identifier in scripts and non-async code

reject.construct: private name where it is not allowed: object-literal method (`{async #a(){}}`, `{get #a(){}}`), destructuring target (`{#a:a}`), block-level `#a(){}`, `#a in` in a for head
class declaration as the body of if/else/for/while/do/with or a label
optional chain as assignment, update or destructuring target (`a?.b = 0`, `a?.b++`, `--a?.b`, `[a?.b] = c`, `(a?.b) = 0`)
for head: `in` expression then `;` (`for(a in b;;)`), or a comma expression after `of`
reserved word written with a Unicode escape used as label or identifier (`tru\u0065:;`, `\u0076oid=0`)
Unicode tables: U+2E2F (vertical tilde) accepted in identifiers, U+180E (Mongolian vowel separator) accepted as white space
raw line terminator inside a string or regular expression literal
unterminated block comment at end of input
HTML-like comments in module code, and `-->` not at line start
hashbang accepted after whitespace or a comment (only valid at the very start)
numeric literal directly followed by an identifier start (`3in[]`)
[no LineTerminator here] restrictions accepted: before `=>`, after `async`, between `yield` and `*`
arrow function (or `async`-prefixed) as a class heritage without parentheses
`??` mixed with `||` or `&&` without parentheses
arrow function used as a binary operand (`()=>{} == a`, `()=>{} = a`, `a in () => {}`)
`yield` as the condition of `?:`
`export default var/let/const ...`, and `export default function(){}()` (a declaration cannot be called)
statement-initial `{...}` taken as an object/pattern: `{}*0`, `{}=0`, `{a:a}={}`
`;` between the body of do-while and `while`
anonymous function declaration as a statement (`function(){}`)
method definition syntax accepted as a statement in a block
`await using` with a destructuring pattern

structure.construct: `for await (let [a] of b)`: `let [a]` is read as a subscript_expression (the plain `for (let [a] of b)` is right)
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `break`/`continue`/`return` followed by CR, LS or PS and a label or expression: the line terminator does not end the statement
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `export` newline `{}`: read as the identifier `export` and a block
`;` after `export default function(){}`/`class{}` belongs to the export_statement; Babel has an empty statement
issues: upstream #323 (same rule: the value is an expression)
structure.tree_change: major (the statement count of valid input changes)

structure.construct: a statement-level block that starts with a label (`{a:0}`) is read as an object
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `await (x)(y)`, `await (a).b()`, `await[0]` in async code: `await` is read as an identifier that is called or indexed, so the operand is cut off
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `await(x)` where `await` is an identifier (script, non-async function): read as await_expression
`<!--` (Annex B single-line HTML-like comment, script only) after code on the same line is read as `<`, `!` and `--`
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `for (using of of [0])`: the declaration `using of` is read as a for-in with the identifier `of`
structure.tree_change: major (the wrong tree is clean today)

structure.construct: `yield` as an identifier in sloppy non-generator code (and in nested functions of generators) is read as yield_expression
